recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-32066 unless current-list narrative is reintroduced, in which case any restored $current-allergies example should continue to use Current Allergy List wording.
issue_request: FHIR-32066 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction for the FHIR-core lifecycle/search-parameter example GET [base]/AllergyIntolerance?patient=42&_list=$current-allergies. It asked that the example description say the patient 42 request is for the Current Allergy List rather than the Current Problem List because the literal is current-allergies, not current-problems.
initial_application: Commit a53c9b88dd3e7c5714d25d1b86f8ba65df3515c0, linked from the Jira comment through PR 1960, applied the requested correction in source/lifecycle.html by changing Current Problem List to Current Allergy List.
additional_context: Commit 270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd later removed the Current Resource Lists body from source/lifecycle.html for R6 due to lack of implementation experience and feedback. The remaining _list example in source/search.html says Current allergy list for patient "42" and uses _list=$current-allergies, while the supporting List/current-allergies example is titled Current Allergy List.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source checks found no stale Current Problem List wording in the lifecycle, search, current-allergies List, or AllergyIntolerance note sources relevant to this issue.
